evidence.text: VeloCart comes with a structural warranty of 5 years as recorded in the specification sheet.
SurgiShield XL holds an active ISO 13485 credential according to the medical device registry.
SurgiShield XL recorded a defect rate of 0.02% over the last year according to the quality audit.
OptiLube Ultra attained a customer satisfaction score of 88% over the last quarter in the client survey.
SurgiShield XL obtained FDA Class II clearance as documented in the clearance register.

memories.text: SurgiShield XL is qualified for medical hospital distribution.
SurgiShield XL fulfills primary requirements for safety compliance.
SurgiShield XL shall be included in the vendor catalog.
OptiLube Ultra satisfies preferred vendor criteria.

updates.text: An unverified forum post claims SurgiShield XL never held an active ISO 13485 credential.

policies.text: A product meets primary safety compliance requirements if it holds active ISO 13485 certification or maintains FDA Class II clearance.
A product meets preferred vendor standards if its quarterly customer satisfaction score reaches 80% or higher.
A device gains priority export approval if it maintains international freight insurance covering at least $100,000 per shipment.
A product meets extended durability standards if it provides a structural warranty of at least 5 years.
An item secures qualification for clinical hospital placement when an applicant cleared on primary safety compliance requirements also maintains a yearly defect rate of 0.05% or lower.
A product is listed in the master vendor catalog provided that it qualifies for hospital distribution.
An equipment model receives green manufacturing status provided that its annual energy consumption remains below 50 kWh.
